drain.quiet_evidence: Pinned TB waits 2000+20000 cycles after target completion; FINAL row has no cycle timestamp.

captured_event_observability.captured: TX rejects, source app rejects/overflow, destination network errors and RM duplicate pulses
captured_event_observability.not_captured: Destination ev_app overflow pin is not logged by the existing executable; any lost/truncated/corrupt output still fails exact delivery checking.

planning_assumptions.page_assumptions: A/B: all short pages reserved until stated lifetime; one full 16-page message per long VL. C: whole messages reserved for a declared 6ms page-residence budget+64 cycles, verified against captured EOF; this is resource-plan safety, not an official long completion limit.
planning_assumptions.app_assumptions: Reserve n+2 bytes from public first-valid until first GMII SOF+16; require first SOF within declared 200us case-planning budget.
planning_assumptions.return_guard_basis: Normal valid traffic has no rollback; page-return FIFO, ret_valid and free-ret1 pending retire long before 64 clocks after final GMII EOF (afdx_tx_builder.v:162-174,374-404; afdx_tx_free.v:48-56,113-133).
planning_assumptions.interpretation: Conservative scenario storage envelopes, not internal counter measurements or official latency formulae.

transient_storage.interpretation: Conservative complete-message reservations from public pins; not DUT allocation/admission observations.

official_FAQ_first_frame_BAG_interpretat: raw comparisons and explicit remaining-eligibility statistics; not a claim that range-minus-full-BAG is universally valid
limitations: Two-state RTL; no X-propagation or VQM evidence.
